summary_en: The Technisches Hilfswerk (THW) Schnell Einsatz Einheit Bergung Ausland (SEEBA) Team (GER-01) has been successfully reclassified from Heavy to Medium USAR team following the classification process conducted from 5 to 9 October 2026 in Austria. The INSARAG Secretariat extends its sincerest congratulations.
summary_zh: 德国技术援助署（THW）海外救援快速行动队（SEEBA）（GER-01）在2026年10月5日至9日于奥地利开展的分级评定流程后，已成功从重型USAR救援队重新分级为中型USAR救援队。INSARAG秘书处致以最诚挚的祝贺。
